notes: LCC places 天地 before 被創造, so <WH08064><WH0776> attach to 天地 and the creation tags attach to 被創造.
永恆主 and 上帝 correspond to 耶和華 and 神 respectively: 永恆主<WH03068>上帝<WH0430>.
LCC has 造地造天 instead of UNV 造天地; <WH0776> attaches to 地 and <WH08064> attaches to 天, while the second 造 is left unannotated as a Chinese stylistic repetition.
<WAH09002> is kept with 日子 as in the UNV tagging convention, even though LCC also has 當 marking the temporal sense.
